features.entity_name: JUNO underground experimental hall, Dashi Hill, Kaiping
features.method: Coordinate published by the JUNO Collaboration (arXiv:2104.02565 Sec. 1.2, repeated in arXiv:1507.05613 Sec. 1.3.1): 112°31'05" E, 22°07'05" N converted to decimal degrees as 112 + 31/60 + 5/3600 and 22 + 7/60 + 5/3600. Arc-second rounding alone is ~21 m; accuracy_m is set to 150 m because the same paper states the hall was moved ~60 m from its design position, does not say which position the quoted coordinate describes or its datum, and the published core baselines imply a position ~100 m SSW of this point (see notes).
features.name: JUNO underground experimental hall (published coordinate, reactor-buildings map)

provenance.locator: arXiv:2104.02565 Sec. 1.2 "JUNO experimental site"; arXiv:1507.05613 Sec. 1.3.1 "Experimental site"
provenance.note: Representation is 'surveyed' (coordinate published by the collaboration) but confidence is kept 'approximate': the coordinate carries arc-second rounding, a stated ~60 m design shift and an ~100 m disagreement with the baselines (see notes).
provenance.quote: The geographic location is 112° 31’05” E and 22° 07’05” N.

features.method: OpenStreetMap way 520344774 (untagged building=yes, ~6396 m2, 19 vertices) kept verbatim. It is identified as the unit's nuclear-island building because the power=generator node 3040238479 (generator:type=EPR, 1660 MW) lies inside it. Core label TS-1 is assigned by matching distance order to the published baselines (52.64 km TS-2, 52.77 km TS-1); the OSM objects carry no unit number.

map.name: JUNO — experimental hall and the Yangjiang and Taishan reactor buildings

summary.plain: The JUNO underground hall and the buildings of the two nuclear power plants whose antineutrinos it measures, to scale: six reactor buildings at Yangjiang and two at Taishan. The collaboration puts the detector 52.5 km from the reactor cores, and its surveyed distances to the individual cores run from 52.11 to 52.82 km. The map shows where the buildings stand; those baselines are checked against the drawn positions, but no baseline lines are drawn.
